target_claim: In any imaginary quadratic number field, if a unit is congruent to 1 modulo a prime ideal above a rational prime p≥3, then the unit equals 1.
source_quote: Let K be a quadratic imaginary number field and $\epsilon$ be a unit in $ {O}_K $ if $ p\geq 3 $ is a prime and  $\wp$    is a prime ideal above p then $ \epsilon \equiv 1 (mod  \wp    ) \Rightarrow \epsilon = 1$
